title: One Light
thesis: A near-black field lit by one source that finds one focal element; everything else is darkness, type and restraint.

light: Exactly one light source per frame; its direction sets every rim, border highlight, text sheen and gradient falloff on the page.
Light falls off into true shell black before the section edge; spill into the next section only on purpose.
composition: One focal element per fold, centred on the optical axis or on the claim's baseline; nothing competes with it.
Generous vertical pacing: the fold breathes, the next section arrives late.
type: One dominant step then a compressed tail (100/50/40/30): the claim at display scale, supporting copy close to UI scale.
Tight tracking on display, no more than two weights on screen.
motion: The light moves, not the layout: slow drift or reveal of the light source under the cinematic tier; UI stays still.
Reduced motion shows the lit end state with no drift.
color: One accent hue per section, carried by the light itself, never a second hue in the same field.
Neutral UI and type; colour exists only in the light and the editorial card fills.

tokenMap.principle: one accent hue in the light
tokenMap.jovie: accent rotation blue (Ion) -> purple (Ultra) -> pink (Pulse); orange rare on marketing; OKLCH chroma is the contrast lever
display scale 32-96 for the claim, UI 14/16 for support; depth ratio 100/50/40/30
cinematic tier (420ms, --ds-motion-cinematic-easing) for reveals; subtle tier for hover; motion-policy intentionality gate
28px ActionButton pill, weight 510, radius 999; 44px invisible hit target

antiGoals: Two hues in one background (reads as stock).
A literal object as the focal point when the background should be abstract light.
Copying any reference's object, streak shape or composition: borrow the lighting logic only.
